create_PickleWidget: create a PickleWidget instance to manage and load network pickle files in the viz GUI
load_pkl: load a network pickle file by path, URL, or run directory into the current visualization
resolve_pkl: resolve a pickle pattern to an absolute file path or URL for loading
list_runs_and_pkls: list all training run directories and network snapshot pickle files under given parent paths
add_recent_pkl: add a resolved pickle path to the recent pickles list for quick access in the GUI
